subject: Application for copy death certificates – William Buckler (1990) and Mary Doreen Williams (1983)
source: Original email in the family's Gmail (read-only export); contact details redacted.
text:
Dear Register Office,

I wish to obtain certified copies of the death certificates for the
following individuals:

1. William (Billy) Buckler
   - Died on or about 29 May 1990 at Llandough Hospital
   - Aged 41
   - Late of Great House Farm, Llandough
   - Likely registered in the Vale of Glamorgan / South Glamorgan district

2. Mary Doreen Williams
   - Born 10 August 1913
   - Death registered March 1983, South Glamorgan (Vol 28, Page 3029)

Please advise the correct office holding each entry, the application
process, current fees (standard and priority), payment methods, and any
additional information required to locate the entries accurately.

I am happy to complete any formal application forms and provide
identification if needed.

Thank you for your assistance.

Yours faithfully,

Requester
